description: This file defines the ProfileReader class responsible for retrieving user profile information from the database, including follower status, and mapping data entities to domain models for API responses.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class that implements IProfileReader to fetch and assemble user profile data, including following status, from the database.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user profile by username, checks follower status if applicable, and returns the profile encapsulated in a ProfileEnvelope.
